summary: Fixed critical bug in continuous playback - next button on single-song albums now correctly fetches recommendations and plays songs from different albums. The issue was a stale closure bug where playFromQueue was called with the old queue length instead of the updated queue after recommendations were fetched.

bugs_fixed.issue: Next button fails on single-song albums - recommendations fetched but song doesn't change
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Stale closure bug in nextSong function - playFromQueue(queue.length) used old queue length instead of updated queue after async fetchAndAddRecommendations
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to use playFromQueueInternal(nextIdx, updatedQueue) with queueRef.current to get the updated queue

critical_code_review_comments: Line 594-598: Fixed stale closure bug - now uses playFromQueueInternal with queueRef.current to get updated queue after async recommendation fetch
Line 607: Added playFromQueueInternal to dependency array
context_for_next_testing_agent: Continuous playback bug has been fixed. The next button now correctly fetches recommendations from /api/recommendations/next-songs and plays songs from different albums. The fix was in useAudioPlayer.js line 594-598 - changed from playFromQueue(queue.length) to playFromQueueInternal(nextIdx, updatedQueue) to avoid stale closure issue.

rca_of_the_issue.problem: Next button on single-song albums fetched recommendations but didn't play the next song
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In nextSong function, after calling fetchAndAddRecommendations (which is async), the code called playFromQueue(queue.length). However, 'queue' was a stale closure value from when the callback was created, not the updated queue with new songs. The queue state update via setQueue() is asynchronous, so queue.length was still 1 even though queueRef.current had 11 songs.
reproduction_steps: 1. Play a song from a single-song album (e.g., 'Kutoka Vilindini')
3. Observe console: recommendations fetched, 10 songs added, but playFromQueueInternal fails with 'Invalid index or empty queue, index: 1 queue length: 1'
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed line 596 from 'playFromQueue(queue.length)' to 'playFromQueueInternal(nextIdx, updatedQueue)' where updatedQueue = queueRef.current (which is updated synchronously in fetchAndAddRecommendations)
